meta_description:
548 likes, 92 comments - luke_coutinho on October 9, 2026: "78 participants. One classroom. Different journeys. One shared vision.

What began as an idea to bring Foundational Medicine into a classroom became something truly meaningful on September 26, 2026.

India’s first batch of the Foundational Medicine & Lifestyle Certification - Level 1: Find Your Rhythm with Luke Coutinho came together at the Harvard Business Classroom, Taj Lands End, Mumbai.

And what a day it was.

A room filled with curiosity, questions, conversations, diverse perspectives and a willingness to look at health differently.

We came together with one purpose: to move beyond isolated information and understand how the foundations of human health connect.

Nutrition. Movement. Sleep. Emotional wellness. Recovery. Our environment. The interconnected systems that shape our health every day.

Through discussions, real-world cases, reflection and shared learning, we explored what it means to look beyond symptoms, connect the dots and understand the body as a whole.

Because education isn't simply about knowing more. It's about expanding how we think, question and apply what we learn.

One of the most meaningful moments was watching conversations turn into insights, strangers become a community, and months of preparation come together in one shared experience.

And as our first cohort received their certificates, we celebrated something beyond a milestone.

We celebrated the commitment to keep learning, growing and carrying this understanding into everyday life.

To our first 78 participants, thank you for being part of this beginning. Your curiosity, energy and participation made this experience what it was.

What began in one classroom now carries forward through many different journeys.

This was our first chapter. And we're looking forward to everything that comes next.

#FoundationalMedicine #LifestyleMedicine #LukeCoutinho #FindYourRhythm #HealthEducation".
